name: Riverbend Bakery

reviewQuotes.text: The cardamom buns are the best thing I have eaten in Topeka. Full stop.
reviewQuotes.author: Megan L.

reviewQuotes.text: I ordered a last-minute birthday cake on a Thursday and they delivered something beautiful. Real people who care.
reviewQuotes.author: David R.

reviewQuotes.text: I drive in from Lawrence every Saturday. That should tell you everything.
reviewQuotes.author: Priya S.

tagline: Small-batch bakery in downtown Topeka. Sourdough, pastries, and cakes worth the drive.
